name: Linear
prompt: Build a Linear-style issue tracker with: kanban board and list views, issue creation with title/description/priority/assignee/status labels, keyboard shortcuts (C to create, J/K to navigate), command palette (Cmd+K), project grouping, filters by status/assignee/label, activity timeline per issue, and dark mode. SQLite backend, REST API, React or vanilla JS frontend with snappy transitions.
notes: Core issue tracking is straightforward. Linear's speed and polish come from years of iteration — your v1 will feel slower but work fine for small teams.
